angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 2,643,660 km at 47.10 pc = 0.75 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Anderson & Francis (2012), Astronomy Letters 38, 331 (XHIP), Hipparcos astrometry, HIP 59803: the Hipparcos parallax (van Leeuwen 2007) the radius is computed with, 21.23 +/- 0.2 mas, inverted (https://doi.org/10.1134/S1063773712050015): 47.103 +/- 0.444 pc; Gaia DR3 cannot see the star
radiusSource: Radius 3.8 +/- 0.31 solar radii from Computed here, not printed by a paper: 3.8 +/- 0.31 solar radii, from the limb-darkened angular diameter 0.75 +/- 0.06 mas of Hanbury Brown, Davis & Allen (1974), MNRAS 167, 121 (the Narrabri intensity interferometer; Code, Davis, Bless & Hanbury Brown (1976), ApJ 203, 417, Table 1, and the JMDC) and the Hipparcos parallax 21.23 +/- 0.2 mas (van Leeuwen 2007, XHIP) (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/167.1.121): 2,643,660 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 12450 +/- 530 K from Code, Davis, Bless & Hanbury Brown (1976), ApJ 203, 417, HD 106625: effective temperature 12450 +/- 530 K (Table 6), from the measured angular diameter and the star's flux from the ultraviolet to the infrared (https://doi.org/10.1086/154093). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Code, Davis, Bless & Hanbury Brown (1976), ApJ 203, 417, HD 106625: effective temperature 12450 +/- 530 K (Table 6), from the measured angular diameter and the star's flux from the ultraviolet to the infrared (https://doi.org/10.1086/154093)
surfaceGravitySource: log g 3.44 +/- 0.14 from 2015ApJ...804..146D, measured from the star's Stroemgren photometry: SIMBAD's compilation holds no spectroscopic gravity of this star (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015ApJ...804..146D)
spectralTypeSource: SIMBAD, * gam Crv: spectral type B8III (1988MSS...C04....0H)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, * gam Crv: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
projectedRotationSpeedSource: SIMBAD, * gam Crv: projected rotation speed 30 km/s, the measurement SIMBAD prefers (2005yCat.3244....0G)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's measured spectrum (Pulkovo spectrophotometric catalogue, table 5 (320-1080 nm, 2.5 nm steps, 10 nm resolution, absolute flux in W m^-2 m^-1)) (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
